title: Emulating XX catalysts for quantum annealing via self-consistent transverse fields
summary: Fully-connected transverse interactions have been considered as catalysts for quantum annealing that could mitigate exponentially small gaps and circumvent first-order phase transitions, but their experimental implementation remains challenging. In this work, we introduce a procedure for emulating their effects via a self-consistent transverse field. All that is required beyond conventional transverse-field annealing is the ability to make measurements in the transverse ($\hatσ^x$) basis.
